Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] crude oil. Petroleum gas is the main ingredient in [[polymer|Polymer]], [[bakelite|Bakelite]], and [[perfluoromethyl|Perfluoromethyl]] making it a key ingredient for progression in all stages of the game. It is also the primary fluid used in [[fracking solution|Fracking Solution]].
